question: The average of first 171 even numbers is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The average of the first n even numbers is directly calculated using the formula: (n + 1).

Given, the number of terms n = 171.

Average = 171 + 1 = 172

**∴ The correct answer is 172.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of even numbers (n) = 171

**Concept Used:**

The sequence of the first n even numbers forms an Arithmetic Progression (AP) with the first term 2 and common difference 2.

Average of an AP = (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2

 Average of First 171 Even Numbers
 
• 
 
 2
 1st Term
 
 342
 171st Term
 
 172
 Average
 Average = (2 + 342) ÷ 2 = 172

**Calculations:**

⇒ First even number (a) = 2

⇒ 171st even number (l) = 171 × 2 = 342

⇒ Average = (a + l) ÷ 2

⇒ Average = (2 + 342) ÷ 2

⇒ Average = 344 ÷ 2

⇒ Average = 172

**∴ The correct answer is 172.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average of first n Odd Numbers

The average of the first n odd numbers is always equal to n. Formula: Average = n.

Sum of first n Even Numbers

The sum of the first n even numbers is calculated by multiplying n with (n + 1). Formula: Sum = n × (n + 1).

Sum of first n Odd Numbers

The sum of the first n odd numbers is equal to the square of n. Formula: Sum = n².

Average of Consecutive Numbers

If a series of numbers are in an Arithmetic Progression, their average is the midpoint. Formula: Average = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2.
